E-001.threat: Privileged command injection via unauthenticated fieldbus protocol into {{targetName}}
E-001.cause: {{dataFlowName}} carries no authorization — {{targetName}} executes all syntactically valid commands regardless of source
E-001.attack: Attacker injects privileged operation commands via {{dataFlowName}} that {{targetName}} executes

E-002.threat: Command injection via embedded bus {{dataFlowName}} to escalate privileges in {{targetName}}
E-002.cause: {{targetName}} processes all commands received on {{dataFlowName}} without source verification
E-002.attack: Attacker injects privileged commands onto the embedded bus that {{targetName}} executes with elevated permissions

E-003.threat: Privilege escalation via {{dataFlowName}} debug interface on {{targetName}}
E-003.cause: JTAG or SWD interface provides full processor access — attacker can halt CPU and modify execution flow
E-003.attack: Attacker uses the {{dataFlowName}} interface to halt the processor, reads security keys and modifies execution flow to bypass access controls
